props.headline: The coolest stuff we saw at the 2026 PGA Merchandise Show.

caption:
Club Pilot was included in Golf Digest's 2026 PGA Merchandise Show roundup, and Golf Bizz Review has covered the communication problem clubs are working through.

The recognition is nice. The more useful thing it points to is that member communication is now a subject the industry press covers on its own.

If you want to see how it would work at your club, the demo is at https://www.clubpilot.com/demo
firstComment: What the Golf Digest piece describes is the simple version: a club loads its common answers, and members can text a question and get one back.
altText: Dark card with the quotation The coolest stuff we saw at the 2026 PGA Merchandise Show, attributed to Golf Digest, 2026, above the label As featured in and the Golf Digest and Golf Bizz Review logos.
earnsItsPlace: Carries Club Pilot's own press recognition, in the locked Golf Digest wording, to the buyer on LinkedIn; no other company can post this proof.
